title: int:Trade
description: An energy trade between a buyer and a seller, from matching through delivery verification. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument. Mirrors the Rust EwdsTradeDto (camelCase wire form; RFC 3339 creation timestamp).

bidId.description: FK to bid Order. IRI: int:bidId.

buyerId.description: FK to buying Actor. IRI: int:buyerId.

residualBidId.description: FK to residual bid Order. IRI: int:residualBidId. Nullable.

offerId.description: FK to offer Order. IRI: int:offerId.

sellerId.description: FK to selling Actor. IRI: int:sellerId.

residualOfferId.description: FK to residual offer Order. IRI: int:residualOfferId. Nullable.

tradeStatus.description: Trade lifecycle status: matched when generated, settled when confirmed on-chain (not financial payment), executed after verification without penalties, or terminal penalized after a delivery penalty. IRI: int:tradeStatus.

tradeQuantity.description: Traded energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:tradeQuantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

tradePrice.description: Settled trade price in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:tradePrice. Unit: EUR/kWh.

timestamp.description: Trade creation timestamp, unchanged by status updates. IRI: int:tradedAt. RFC 3339. Lifecycle notifications carry the status-change time in the event envelope's occurredAt.
